Package model

Class IngredientManager

java.lang.Object
model.IngredientManager
public class IngredientManager extends Object
Manages ingredient stock, stock validation, and ingredient updates for orders, order items, and menu items. Responsible for checking availability and updating persistent storage via MenuDAOImpl.

28 maj
